superseded_successful_attempts.reason: Initial transfer cases extended with per-pending-operation revision reservation; included once in final territory regression.

known_open: This is an internal cuboid ownership primitive, not an authorized treaty or siege receiver. No player settlement entry is enabled by this checkpoint.
Cuboid owner UUID and separate nation affiliation retain their existing meanings. No cuboid UUID is silently replaced with a foundation chunk identity.
Transfer preserves metadata, permissions, child images and existing delegated membership, except that target-owner membership is removed from the parent as in the compatibility transfer API.
Persistent original envelope, immutable binding, War/Diplomacy source proof, receiver lifecycle and whole-manifest production orchestration remain the next step.
Foundation chunk receiver, lease/reparation/tribute/loan money receipts, legacy military restriction migration and permissioned lifting remain open.
Navy transport/ports, wounded return, doctrine, budget rollover/cancel, other module authorization/thread/lifecycle paths and archival remain open.
Pending transfer history is permanent and bounded; automatic archival or expiry is not implemented.
Event final authorization is not atomic with later vanilla world mutation; SQL multiprocess cache consistency and live entity origin behavior remain unverified.
Full clean Core build, new artifacts, final Core plus Supply regression, SQL multiprocess/MySQL and user-deferred Paper/Folia acceptance remain open.
